resolution.title: [Snappi] Validate PFC Pause Frames Counting Function if the src MAC is zero
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary: Sending PFC traffic with src MAC zero, validate the PFC RX counter should count for those frames. Certain versions of OS loaded onto DUTs did not count PFC frames if they had zero source MAC. This is not the intended behavior for the DUT.

Fixes #6172

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)

### Back port request
- [x] 201911
- [x] 202012
- [x] 202205

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Certain versions of OS loaded onto DUTs did not count PFC frames if they had zero source MAC. This is not the intended behavior for the DUT. Thus test was written to fill this DUT behavioral gap.

#### How did you do it?
Send PFC Pause frames with zero source MAC from a traffic generator to the DUT (device under test) to see if these PFC Pause Frames packets are being counted.

Here is the general topo:
traffic gen(port 1) --- dut ---- traffic gen(port 2)

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran the test on the switch in the lab.
